scope: 16 fixed development/regression cases; not independent generalization evidence; no inference or training

configuration.reference_geometry: float64; original diagnosis retained without recomputation

selection.success_population_order: ascending sample_index among official-valid enhanced cases
selection.candidate_policy: diagnose_results.selection; same enhanced-selected index for raw and enhanced
selection.failure_selection_note: Minimum official thresholded overlap then highest utilization; not minimum exact overlap

verification.scope: Coverage/configuration, full saved output hashes, unchanged inputs, summary recomputation; not a new independent geometry recomputation

baseline_evidence.validation_scope: Completed verified baseline, summary recomputation, diagnosis binding, selected saved-file hashes/configuration; original source files and unselected output tensors are not reverified here
